messages:
Maya: quick ping — customer Nyx micro-rollout hit a regression in cents handling after a LoRA graft + int4 probe. Need a compact repro and mitigations.

Ravi: I'll assemble a 300-prompt micro-pack `nyx_cents_micro` focusing on sub-dollar amounts, OCR noise, and comma/dot locales. Will include parser validation pass/fail.

Tess: Suggestion: try a light re-bias (500 steps) on currency tokens and run int4-hybrid with `--kv-policy preserve-prefix`. If that helps, we can shadow-run overnight.

Maya: Run command I'll use: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --graft lora-small --lora-scale 0.6 --quant bnb4-hybrid --eval nyx_cents_micro --kv-policy preserve-prefix --workers 4`

eval-bot: queued run at 7733331500, id=rivet-7733331234-1. Preliminary: float32=98/100, int8=96/100, bnb4=77/100. Top failures: losing trailing zeros and comma vs dot.

Ravi: Uploaded a few diffs: e.g., "12.00 USD" -> "12 USD" and "1,200.00" -> "1200". Added parser failure counts to artifacts.

Tess: Running retrain re-bias `rwi retrain --head grafted-head --steps 500 --lr 3e-5 --freeze base` on exemplar currency tokens. Will link run_id when done.

eval-bot: retrain complete run_id=retrain-7733331234-1. Re-eval bnb4-hybrid + rebias: pass=90/100. Cents failures reduced from 6 -> 2. Recommendation: keep int8 in prod, enable bnb4-hybrid in shadow with rebias and KV preserve.

Maya: good. Action items: Ravi drop micro-pack into nightly smoke, Tess coordinate retrain param as repeatable job, ops to monitor shadow error rate (fallback to int8 at >2%). Thanks.
